findings.title: Known own member named bind suppresses actual HTTP and SQL invocation
findings.scope: Bounded literal/stored own object and array members; static rest/spread, optional/computed access, nested containers and known bound SQL aliases
findings.root_cause: visit uses member(expression) !== bind to suppress known HTTP/query effects regardless of projected callable origin. Mutation pass also skips such calls as bindConstruction. An own data property bind holding fetch or db.query is an invocation, not intrinsic Function.prototype.bind construction.
findings.impact: Static audit returns PASS/exit 0/findings [] for direct external HTTP and synthetic clinical-table UPDATE in a pre-kernel scanned source, including bound SQL prefixes. Violates focused Q13 measurement contract; no real effect was executed.

findings.reason: UPDATE is outside the authorized SQL write boundary

findings.recommendation: Determine intrinsic bind construction from the callable/receiver origin; inspect invocation of known own bind properties as normal calls. Keep actual uninvoked native binds inert and paired pure members accepted.

findings.title: Benign query.apply arguments are tainted before SQL projection
findings.scope: Known static query.apply arrays, including literal, alias, rest/slice/spread copies
findings.root_cause: Mutation/escape pass exempts raw argument index 0 for query, but query.apply SQL arguments reside in index 1. Its argument array is marked mutated/escaped; invocationSqlArgument subsequently requires an unmutated SQL-projected array and returns unresolved.
findings.impact: Six pure SELECT or authorized quota controls fail with direct_sql_write/unresolved_query_expression. Conservative false rejection; no unsafe PASS attributable to this cause was observed. No production-source differential was conducted.
findings.recommendation: Normalize call/apply effective query arguments before escape classification; use the shared bounded materialization for static argument arrays.

findings.title: Known nested spread in query bind prefix is rejected
findings.scope: Static literal array spread supplying a known bound SQL prefix
findings.root_cause: boundArguments expands spread operands from raw array.elements and refuses any SpreadElement instead of using materialized array values. Complete nested literal spread is therefore unresolved despite known primitives.
findings.impact: One authorized quota positive is rejected with unresolved_query_expression. Conservative precision gap, with both simple known bind-spread controls accepted.

sentinel.read_policy: Python file/directory reads O_NOATIME; Node libc opens read-only target paths O_NOATIME through own LD_PRELOAD. readlink and Git inventory can read without O_NOATIME; measured zero atime changes, including all 43 symlinks. Symlinks are not followed by sentinel. No xattr/ACL separate sampling.

harness.root_routing: Own --import root-shim.mjs changes only builtin fileURLToPath for the exact entrypoint URL, so its fixed import.meta-derived inventory root becomes the own disposable Git fixture. Target module and helper are executed unchanged; no AST/SQL transform or stub. This is a root-boundary injection because CLI has no root option.
harness.fixtures: Each contains exactly one untracked synthetic source in a scoped path and a newly initialized Git repository. Git inventory and TypeScript parsing succeed, scannedFiles=1 on all 149 cases. Fixture code is never executed.
harness.noatime: own noatime.so wraps read-only target libc open/open64/openat with O_NOATIME. Any paths outside that interception, including readlink/Git inventory, are covered by exact measured atime comparison.
harness.raw: results.json, followup-results.json, raw/<id>.stdout and .stderr; case objects include exact source, CLI argv, fixture root, env overrides, source hash and exit/status
harness.writes: Only own TEMP; no installs, DB, Docker, network, commits, pushes, source edits or target caches
harness.interruption: User checkpoint interrupted after all CLI processes and final sentinel had already completed. No probe, sentinel or source operation was partially executed; report writing resumed on request.

limitations: Finite focused host/SQL probe coverage; not universal static JavaScript or PostgreSQL proof.
No arbitrary reflection/prototypes, unknown external PostgreSQL function semantics or general interprocedural inference claim.
SQL helper source inspected and 15 public CLI SQL controls passed their expected statuses; no material helper finding observed in this sample.
P2 findings are conservative false rejections, not unsafe acceptance.
Sentinel tracks all entries except .git, content hashes of regular files and listed metadata/symlink targets; extended ACL/xattr values were not separately sampled.
No project runtime/log/backlog was updated because explicit user READONLY restrictions override repository persistence requirements; lead must reconcile review evidence.
Focused REJECT does not constitute final Gauntlet/global readiness certification.
stop_reason: Relevant bounded independent probes complete; one material P1 is sufficient to reject. No further scope expansion.
